name: paper-espresso
description: Read a research paper completely and turn its essential mental model into a compact LaTeX technical reference with source and verified PDF output.

interface.shortDescription: Build compact technical references for papers.
interface.longDescription: Resolve and read a complete paper from original source or PDF, then create a page-budgeted technical reference for rapid consultation and reconstruction of its central reasoning as LaTeX source plus verified PDF.
defaultPrompt: Read this paper completely and create a one-page technical reference that preserves its essential mental model.
Create a two-page mathematical reference for this arXiv paper.
Create a compact reference for rapidly reconstructing this paper's central reasoning.
